Yang Jiabo, a veteran in committing su*cide with snake spirit illness, finally succeeded in killing himself. He believed that at this point he could be freed. But those who commit su*cide are destined to be ‘punished’. So he returned to the time when he was six years old. Whether to repeat the same mistakes or to live a new life, it was a difficult challenge for someone with snake spirit illness like him, because he simply didn’t want to live.
Wei Jing: It wasn’t his original wish to fall in love with someone who had snake spirit illness, but the kindness of saving his life should be returned with a spring. The savior with snake spirit illness was unmarketable, so he reluctantly devoted his life to him.

100459.synopsis:
Top star Wei Yuan turned into a cat.
And he was picked up by his rival – the movie emperor rumored to enjoy dissecting small animals.
To survive, the kitten was cautious and wary in front of the movie emperor, acting cute and obedient, while always ready to run.
But soon, the kitten discovered that the movie emperor was actually a late-stage cat s*ave.
The kind of cat s*ave who secretly enjoys being punched twice by a kitty!
So, the kitty dropped the act!
It ate well, played well, rolled around in the movie emperor’s bed, and boxed on his pecs.
Just when Wei Yuan thought being a kitten wasn’t so bad, he turned back into a human.
****
The entertainment industry’s recognized rivals – the top star and the movie emperor – appeared on the same variety show, shocking the entire internet.
Before the show aired, everyone thought –
With Wei Yuan’s temper, I’ll wash my hair upside down if he doesn’t give the movie emperor a hard time!
Sure enough, on the show, Wei Yuan was completely possessed by a drama queen, especially when facing the movie emperor.
He not only ordered him to pour water and serve food but also made him massage his waist and legs. When tired, he even demanded to be carried upstairs and piggybacked up mountains…
He even wanted the movie emperor to coax him to sleep, calling it a reward for the movie emperor.
Everyone was shocked: Do you want this reward yourself?!
Wei Yuan acted spoiled and entitled, oblivious to the movie emperor’s increasingly dark gaze.
Until he visited the movie emperor’s house with other guests. Upon entering, he naturally jumped onto the giant cat tree in the living room…
Across from him, the movie emperor slowly curled his lips.

100715.synopsis:
Blurb 1:
Yu Xiang’an dies unexpectedly while saving someone but wakes up as a high school student in a small county in the 1970s. Just as she’s about to celebrate her second chance at life, she faces two major challenges:
1. Her fiancé is seduced by her stepsister, who ends up pregnant.
2. She’s about to be sent to the countryside as a “sent-down youth” to farm.
Yu Xiang’an: “..This won’t do.”
With a fierce and decisive attitude, she resolves both problems in no time. But then another issue arises-how can she fall asleep at night when she’s starving?
That’s when she discovers her cheat: a farming game system!
In this era, what’s in high demand?
Food and meat!
The system allows her to plant crops and harvest them instantly. With this golden finger, Yu Xiang’an stockpiles resources and eventually rises to prominence. After the reform and opening-up period, she builds a food empire, paving her way to wealth and success.
Years later, during a live interview:
The reporter asks,
“Your restaurant chain spans the country, from hot pot to fast food to five-star hotels. Many people call you the ‘King of Dining.’ What would you like to say about this title?”
Before Yu Xiang’an can answer, the live comments explode:
“Thanks for the invite. That title’s too narrow—aside from the food court outside my door, the office building across the street also belongs to her. [hands on hips] ”
“Not just the office building—she also owns a share in the fashion mall. [smug] ”
“And let’s not forget, she dominates half of the cosmetics industry too. [evil grin] ”
“Oh, and don’t overlook the first-aid kits at home. She’s got a stake in that too! [doge face] ”
…
Blurb 2:
Both Yu Xiang’an and Lin Chuanbai die while saving others and end up transmigrating to the 1970s.
Yu Xiang’an becomes the innocent stepsister who was cheated on by her stepsister, while Lin Chuanbai is the unlucky student whose slot at the prestigious Worker-Peasant-Soldier University was stolen. Both must adapt to their new lives, equipped with their own golden fingers.
One fateful day, they cross paths.
Yu Xiang’an: “…What a coincidence.”
Lin Chuanbai: “Yeah, really coincidental.”
Yu Xiang’an: “Did you die back then too?”
Lin Chuanbai: “Yes.”
Yu Xiang’an glanced at his shoes with toes exposed, and sighed, “…Life is not easy these days.”
Lin Chuanbai glanced at the wild vegetable dumplings in her hand, and said with emotion, “…Yes, life is not easy.”
They exchange a knowing look and walk away, pretending not to recognize each other.
The next day, they meet again—this time at the black market.
Yu Xiang’an eyes the wild ginseng in his hand. “…!”
Lin Chuanbai looks at the fat duck and apples in hers. “…!”
“Life is not easy?”
Ha! The man’s/woman’s words are nothing but lies!
Reading Guide: Focus on career development and slice-of-life in the 1970s.
associated_names: Bringing a Game Farm to the 1970s

101227.synopsis: Strength, Agility, Intelligence, Luck. Anyone can see these are god tier stats. But why is my actual intelligence dropping?

104811.synopsis: The Unofficial Strongest Assassin Hunter, Ha Dojin, returns to the past from the claws of death.

105067.synopsis:
The boss (the goddess) didn’t know about the final boss’ struggles
After (possibly) dying from overwork, the protagonist, Jiro Hasegawa, found himself reincarnated as a dungeon monster in another world. Through sheer effort and continuous evolution, he eventually rose to the position of the final boss, entrusted with guarding the deepest part of the dungeon.
Even though he kept working hard, one day, his boss—the goddess—suddenly deemed him too costly to maintain and attempted to transfer him to another dungeon… or so he thought. Instead, he got fired.
However, the place he ended up in was Earth.
Taking on a human form, Jiro found that time had barely progressed on Earth. And so, he decided to enjoy the continuation of his previous life.
Anyway, time to enjoy my retirement life!~

Becoming an immortal has always been the ultimate obsession and dream of every cultivator.
Bai Sumu, a transmigrator from another world, aspired to become a Sword Immortal who mastered dazzling sword techniques.
However… no matter how hard he tried, he could never grasp the essence of those exquisite sword moves.
Yet, just when all seemed lost, he found his own path to becoming a Sword Immortal.
No matter how many enemies stand before me—with a single sword, I shall cut them all down.

After rescuing a party of beautiful female streamer-adventurers from a black dragon that appeared as an irregular threat inside the dungeon, my existence was suddenly exposed to the public.
As the masked adventurer who constantly sparked a storm of reactions in the comment section, I eventually decided to create my own clan.

107627.synopsis:
Hirabayashi Rinta, a third-year employee with zero dating experience, suddenly receives a transfer order. His new workplace? An office staffed by only three stunningly beautiful women.
The older office manager, as beautiful as a model but strict at work.
A co-worker with idol-like looks who boldly claims she only dates handsome men.
A cool-looking, glasses-wearing junior, who turns out to be surprisingly kind.
Anyone would say these women were “way out of his league!” and completely unapproachable. With no experience handling women, Rinta wondered whether he’d be able to get along with them…
But he soon vowed to himself:
“Work is work—gender doesn’t matter. I’ll just give it my all.”
Then, for some reason…
“Wait… are they starting to like me?”
A romantic comedy begins!

107883.synopsis:
Lin Sui transmigrated into a book as the scapegoat male wife of the gloomy, disabled protagonist.
The original owner of the body was sold by his parents to this “old man” (seven years his senior). Furious, the original owner relentlessly ab*sed and insulted the powerful figure (‘Dalao’/Big Shot). Consequently, when the Big Shot eventually turned the tables, the original owner had both his legs broken, was thrown onto a garbage heap, and ultimately brought about his own demise through his reckless actions.
When Lin Sui transmigrated, he found himself right at the wedding ceremony. Just as he contemplated escaping, he met the Big Shot’s dark, sullen eyes.
The man sat in a wheelchair, shadows swirling in the depths of his gaze, radiating a sudden chill.
Lin Sui: ! Feeling his own healthy legs—something unimaginable in his previous life—Lin Sui trembled and shrank back. He decided it was best to obediently play the part of a nominal wife and simply wait for the Big Shot to initiate a divorce, at which point he would pack his bags and leave.
After the wedding, Lin Sui looked at the Big Shot’s disabled legs, so similar to his own in his past life. A sense of empathy stemming from their shared plight made him unconsciously draw closer.
Sigh, he’s so pitiful. I should help him.
Going out to pray at a temple, he sincerely knelt and asked for a blessed bracelet, which he then tied onto the Big Shot’s pale wrist. Looking up, his almond eyes were bright and sparkling, his voice clear as he said, “This will protect you and help you get better.”
The Big Shot had no income, and they could barely afford groceries. Lin Sui revived skills from his past life, started live streaming to become an internet celebrity, and worked hard to support the Big Shot, aiming to keep him well-fed and healthy. “Don’t worry, I’ll support the family!”
When vile relatives showed up to provoke them, the Big Shot was triggered and locked himself in his room to nurse his emotional wounds. Lin Sui fiercely drove the relatives away, then held the Big Shot close, comforting him softly, “It’s okay. If they don’t want you, I do!”
Pitying him more and more, Lin Sui suddenly realized he seemed to have lost his heart somewhere along the way.
But the male lead was meant for the book’s original hero(ine)… right? Hiding under the covers all night, Lin Sui resolved to snatch the Big Shot for himself.
Armed with dating tips found online, Lin Sui braced his small hand and performed an “overbearing wheelchair-don” on the Big Shot: “Man, you’re playing with fire.”
The Big Shot, who was merely attempting to make his ‘wife’ a heartfelt breakfast: “?”
Later, not only did the Big Shot’s legs heal, but he also staged a comeback and reclaimed everything he had lost. Lin Sui, gratified, packed his small bag, ready to pursue his own dream.
The beautiful world I couldn’t see in my past life, here I come!
Lin Sui eagerly rubbed his hands together, but before he could even open the car door, the Big Shot scooped him into his arms. The man’s voice was low and gentle, “Be good. I’ll go with you.”
Lin Sui: !
Later, Lin Sui lay in bed, clutching his aching waist, wanting to cry but having no tears left.
There was no way he could leave the house like this!
The day Lin Sui tried to run away, Gu Nian (the Big Shot’s real name) pinned him on the sofa, eyes bloodshot, voice hoarse: “Do you like me or not?”
Lin Sui shrank back and timidly shook his head.
“…”
Only on that day did Gu Nian realize that his ‘sunshine’ didn’t actually love him; he had only stayed out of pity. Now that his legs were healed, his sun was planning to go warm someone else.
Heh, don’t even think about it.
His sun could only shine for him alone.
Gu Nian had always believed Lin Sui was desperately in love with him.
Until Lin Sui, choking back sobs, confessed he only pitied him. Gu Nian’s world shattered.
Doesn’t love me? Then I’ll just lock him up until he does.

118635.synopsis:
祀风师乐舞; Sì Fēngshī Yuèwǔ, which means Music and Dance of the Wind Worshipers, is the second dance in a series of Jiu Gong dance techniques, which is a prequel to the Fragrance Dance—First Stage.

He was like an ominous Plumeria, indifferent and cruel, yet lonelier than anyone.
She, on the other hand, was like a cherry blossom in spring—finding joy in watching over him even in death.
Because of a cursed bloodline, they once lost each other. It was unwillingness—unwillingness to be torn apart by fate before they even had the chance to love. So, he vowed to bring her back to life. If not as a human, then as a spirit—just so she could watch the sunrise with him every day.
Heaven, you must know—this betrayal is one you forced upon me.

119147.synopsis:
Xie Yuanxing has a roommate he really hates.
The guy is an Alpha — not just any Alpha, but one with SSS-level physique, wealthy family background, and senior status. He’s the school heartthrob adored by countless fans.
Meanwhile, Xie Yuanxing is just an ordinary Beta — gloomy, quiet, and utterly unremarkable. His greatest skill is blending into the background like a forgettable extra in group settings.
No one knows that this so-called average Beta actually hides bite marks at the back of his neck — marks left by that top-tier Alpha school hunk.
That’s the root of Xie Yuanxing’s loathing for Shen Bianye.
Shen Bianye had lived a smooth-sailing life for twenty years — until he stumbled, hard, over a Beta.
All thanks to his damn pheromone dysregulation disorder, a condition that made him mistake a Beta for an Omega during his rut.
He bit, l**ked, and claimed this gloomy little Beta mushroom hiding in the shadows, a boy he would never have looked at twice. But his pheromones didn’t lie — to his body, Xie Yuanxing was an Omega.
When the little Beta was happy, Shen Bianye tasted sweetness.
When he was upset, it turned bitter.
Sadness brought sourness.
Anger — spiciness.
Even though he disliked the idea, Shen Bianye still drove five hours just to buy that one cake the little Beta liked — and then coaxed him to take a bite of sweetness.
But Shen Bianye had never coaxed anyone before, let alone a Beta.
So while doing all the sweet things, his mouth kept running with sarcastic jabs:
“What’s a Beta being so sensitive about?”
“You can’t even finish the project. Getting scolded serves you right.”
“Don’t tell a soul I bit you. If anyone finds out, you’re dead meat.”
Still, he tutored him, fought for him, and schemed to take him to the city’s most dazzling fireworks display.
Everyone around them thought Shen Bianye had fallen for a Beta.
Shen Bianye scoffed: “Who’d fall for a Beta?”
Then came the day his pheromone disorder was cured.
Xie Yuanxing was busy moving out of their dorm.
Shen Bianye was busy partying at a bar with his friends.
Drunk and reeking of alcohol, he returned to an empty dorm room and caught sight of a piece of clothing the Beta had forgotten to take with him.
On impulse, like a pe*vert, he buried his face in it — and inhaled.

“What? Fear of horses?”
Emperor Herius von Prahel, who suddenly developed a fear of horses.
Elsei Azentine, the Empire’s finest riding instructor, secretly goes to the imperial palace to help him.

“Sweet. It smells of lilac and peach.”

She didn’t have the slightest intention of tasting such a thing.

After his parents’ divorce, Zou Yang finds himself caught between two uneasy households. His father has a daughter he never knew about, a middle schooler born of an affair, while his mother seems dangerously entangled with a man who might be scamming her. Determined to uncover the truth, Zou Yang sets out to investigate this so-called Uncle Lü his mother seems enamoured by.
His search leads him to Fan Jun, a reclusive martial arts coach who never leaves the decaying neighbourhood of Nanzhouping. Haunted by a shadowed past, Fan Jun keeps to the martial art studio and crumbling streets of Nanzhouping, as though they were his only safe haven.
But as Zou Yang is drawn deeper into Nanzhouping’s bleak alleys, the ghosts of the past threaten to surface once more.

143211.synopsis:
Cang Ran transmigrated into a book. In the book, she was the villainous supporting character—a red fox spirit. In her bid to gain the Male Lead’s attention, she constantly clashed with the Female Lead, ultimately failing and dying. Her inner core was even dug out and used as a medicinal pill.
Cang Ran decisively slipped away, claimed a mountain as her territory, and unexpectedly picked up a beautiful woman who was severely injured. She took her home to be her wife. The woman was aloof and serene, her complexion like snow, and she was constantly confined to her sickbed. When passion was deep, she would only tightly bite her lower lip and ask Cang Ran to call her “Qingqing.” Cang Ran was smitten by the beauty and didn’t care about anything else. Her wife’s waist was soft, she was gentle and passionate, and her lips were sweet to kiss.
The demons within a hundred-mile radius mocked her for marrying a sickly human woman. Hehe, you demons cannot imagine the joy of this fox.
The blissful life didn’t last long. Her fox den was nearly burned down by the Male Lead, and she herself was almost eliminated by demon-slayers. It was at that critical moment that her seemingly fragile wife, whom Cang Ran was supposed to protect, wielded a long sword, saved her fox life, and even crippled the Male Lead’s immortal root. Numerous immortal sect members bowed before her. Only then did Cang Ran realize that her wife was actually the peerless Qing Xuan Immortal Venerable, born with a Sword Bone, who was undergoing a cultivation tribulation and was severely injured. She was supposed to return to the immortal sect to succeed the sect leader position, but she had been “defiled” by Cang Ran, this shameless wild fox.
In the original novel, Qing Xuan Immortal Venerable would later take the Female Lead as her disciple, indulge her disciple in digging out the fox’s inner core, thereby advancing the Female Lead’s cultivation. The fox spirit would then die a miserable death, unmourned and forgotten.
Cang Ran immediately packed her bags overnight and fled back to her fox mountain.
Not long after, she was cornered by Qing Xuan Immortal Venerable at her new cave dwelling. The cold and beautiful woman’s eyes were frosty, and she looked noticeably thinner, save for a slight bulge in her lower abdomen. She closed the distance between them and suddenly kissed Cang Ran.
Cang Ran was stunned by the kiss: “…….”
The aloof beauty hugged her: “A’Ran, are you abandoning me and the baby?”

148331.synopsis:
Tinya dreams of meeting her mate and forming a peaceful group.
Her tranquil daily life is shattered by a tiger cub she rescues on a rainy day.
“Let me stay here for a few days… no, a few months.”
A sudden cohabitation request from the tiger shifter.
She only wanted him to leave as soon as possible during those uncomfortable days…
“Don’t worry about money and turn on the hot water.”
“Then we should just buy a refrigerator.”
“And I’d like to see a bed too.”
He’s helpful! To the point of being burdensome!
***
‘Trying to repay me just to ease your own conscience.’
Such gestures weren’t gratitude but merely another name for a sense of debt. The immediate urge to lighten the burden as soon as something is given.
She seemed overwhelmed to the brim, but that was actually a good thing.
The more burdened she felt, the more she would consider his presence here as natural. Whatever emotion she was feeling, he had no intention of relieving even 1g of it.
Just let her try to repay him.
His words about staying temporarily had already disappeared without a trace.
A tenacious determination to remain by her side had taken their place.

153195.synopsis:

With her boyish features and tall stature, she is the number one beautiful girl people “want as a boyfriend.” However, for some reason, she adopts an aloof attitude only toward me and constantly teases me; she is my hateful rival in love. And yet…
“My real target is you, Souta. Go out with me.”
T-This girl, she suddenly pinned me against the wall! Moreover, she started saying things like, “I’ll make you fall in love with me during a one-month trial dating period”… There is no way I’ll ever fall for someone like you!
A one-way romantic comedy where I’m seduced every day by a handsome beautiful girl!

165483.synopsis:
Jiang Mi is the Empress Dowager’s niece — a woman who was forced upon the Emperor. Even knowing full well that her imperial step cousin held no affection for her, she had stubbornly followed her heart into his inner palace. A great deal of scheming, and yet her end had not been a pleasant one.
After her rebirth, Jiang Mi came to her senses. Rather than waste a lifetime on an Emperor whose heart would never be hers, she would find herself someone who actually cherished her.
The young master of the Grand Councillor’s family — refined and courteous. The young master of the Loyal Valor Marquis’s household — gallant and handsome. The heir of the Duke Zhenguo’s estate — gentle and agreeable. Jiang Mi counted her prospects on her fingers, quietly mapping out her plans.
When the Empress Dowager sought a boon from the new Emperor on her niece’s behalf, everyone assumed the Jiang family would seize the opportunity to secure Jiang Mi a place in the imperial harem.
The new Emperor watched calmly as Jiang Mi, cheeks flushed, murmured in a small voice: “This subject’s daughter wishes to… to ask Your Majesty to grant her a marriage decree.”
The Emperor, ordinarily so temperate and gracious, let a flash of something dangerous cross his eyes. The jade archer’s ring he had been turning idly between his fingers crumbled to dust.
